name: Coastal Land Terrain
description:
Adds the Coastal Land terrain (with map decorations, mines, a battlefield and terrain music) and makes it the native terrain of Atlantis.

Coastal Land terrain originally by Zeryss (Coastal Lands); adapted by yche2990: lighter ground tiles, terrain music from the Age of Mythology: Retold soundtrack, random map biomes, and no dependency on the HotA map decorations.

chinese.name: 海滩地形
chinese.description:
加入海滩地形（含地图装饰、矿场、战场背景和地形音乐），并把它设为大西洲的本地地形。

海滩地形原作者 Zeryss（Coastal Lands）；yche2990 调淡了地表草丛、换用《神话时代：重述版》原声作为地形音乐、加了随机地图生态配置，并去掉了对 HotA 地图装饰的依赖。

author: Zeryss (terrain), yche2990 (adaptation)
